nodes.title: Equationally Noetherian groups (Kourovka 14.20)

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a group and $n$ a natural number. An equation over $G$ in the unknowns $x_0, \dots, x_{n-1}$ is an element of the free product $G * F(x_0, \dots, x_{n-1})$ of $G$ with the free group on $x_0, \dots, x_{n-1}$. For an assignment $a = (a_0, \dots, a_{n-1}) \in G^n$, evaluation at $a$ is the group homomorphism $G * F(x_0, \dots, x_{n-1}) \to G$ that is the identity on $G$ and sends each unknown $x_i$ to $a_i$.
nodes.title: Evaluating an equation at an assignment

nodes.summary: For a group $G$, let $F_n$ be the free group on the unknowns $t_0, \dots, t_{n-1}$. For an assignment $x = (x_0, \dots, x_{n-1}) \in G^n$, evaluation at $x$ is the group homomorphism $G * F_n \to G$ from the free product of $G$ and $F_n$ that is the identity on $G$ and sends $t_i$ to $x_i$ for each $i < n$; it sends an equation $w \in G * F_n$ over $G$ to its value $w(x)$ at $x$.
nodes.title: Evaluation of an equation at an assignment (Kourovka 14.20)

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a group, $n$ a natural number and $S$ a set of equations over $G$ in the unknowns $x_0, \dots, x_{n-1}$, that is, a subset of the free product $G * F(x_0, \dots, x_{n-1})$ of $G$ with the free group on $x_0, \dots, x_{n-1}$. The solution set of $S$ is the set of assignments $a \in G^n$ at which every $w \in S$ evaluates to $1$.
nodes.title: Solution set of a system of equations

nodes.summary: For a group $G$, let $F_n$ be the free group on the unknowns $t_0, \dots, t_{n-1}$. The solution set of a set $S \subseteq G * F_n$ of equations over $G$ is the set of assignments $x = (x_0, \dots, x_{n-1}) \in G^n$ such that $w(x) = 1$ for every $w \in S$, where $w(x)$ is the image of $w$ under the homomorphism $G * F_n \to G$ that is the identity on $G$ and sends $t_i$ to $x_i$.
